item.title: ASAP Branded Wix Website Build
item.description:
30-250 AUD | I have a complete style guide, licensed imagery and several reference sites ready to go—I now need a Wix specialist who can translate all of that into a polished, responsive website that feels unmistakably on-brand. From first click the visitor should know who we are, glide through clear navigation and, most importantly, feel compelled to send an enquiry.
Here is what I need you to deliver: • Pixel-perfect layouts that hold their own on desktop, tablet and mobile. • Faithful use of the supplied colours, typography, iconography and photos. • A structured Wix CMS so my team can add, edit and organise content without touching code. • All agreed pages live, with an enquiry form wired up and tested. • Basic on-page SEO, image compression and WCAG-minded accessibility tweaks baked in. • Cross-browser and cross-device testing prior to launch. • A short recorded or written hand-over showing how to update both the site and the CMS.
Final page count, any extra integrations and app installs can be locked down together before development begins. I’m aiming for an ASAP turnaround, so availability to start right away is important. If you’ve shipped similar Wix projects before and can meet this timeline, I’d love to hear how you would approach it.

item.title: Clone Peptide Shop Website
item.description:
15-25 AUD/hr | I need an e-commerce site that mirrors every page and feature of https://australianpeptidelabs.com.au/ while swapping the blue palette for a fresh green and re-branding all instances to “Australian Peptide Co.” From the public storefront through to the customer account area, blog, shipping calculator and discount code functions, everything visible (and under the hood) on the reference site should be replicated.
I’ll supply the full catalogue—product names, descriptions, images and pricing—so you can focus on design, build and configuration. Customers must be able to complete their purchase with standard credit or debit cards, so please connect a reliable card gateway (Stripe or a comparable option you recommend).
Deliverables • Pixel-level match to the reference layout, typography and user flow, recoloured in green and updated branding • Responsive design that performs smoothly on desktop, tablet and mobile • Secure card-payment checkout fully tested end-to-end • All pages, menus and functional elements from the source site recreated and online with my provided content loaded • Final deployment on my hosting plus a short admin walk-through so I can manage products and orders myself
If you normally work in WordPress + WooCommerce, Shopify, or another modern e-commerce stack, let me know which you prefer and why; I’m open as long as it delivers the identical experience and easy self-management afterward.

item.title: Squarespace Design Refresh Needed
item.description:
750-1500 USD | My Squarespace site for my therapy business is live, but the look and feel still miss the mark. I want it to lean darker and slightly moody, with touches of greenery and a bit of “magic” in the visual details while retaining a clean, modern structure.
The first goal is aesthetic: richer tones, refined typography, and imagery that conveys that atmosphere. At the same time, every change should guide visitors toward one primary action—filling in the contact form—so the page hierarchy, calls-to-action, and mobile layout must all support that journey naturally.
I’m happy for you to work inside Squarespace’s built-in editor, and if light custom CSS or micro-animations will elevate the experience, feel free. Just keep the site easy for me to update afterward.
Deliverables • Revamped styling or template tweaks that achieve the dark, plant-infused, magical aesthetic • Prominent, intuitive contact-form CTA on all key pages, fully responsive and tested • Short hand-off video or live walkthrough so I can maintain the design on my own
The content stays; you refine the visuals and polish the user experience. If you have examples of mood-driven Squarespace builds, send them over—I’m ready to move forward.

item.title: E-commerce Site for Digital Art

Key Requirements: - User-friendly interface - Secure payment processing - Mobile-responsive design - High-quality image display
Ideal Skills: - Experience with e-commerce platforms - Proficiency in web design and development - Knowledge of SEO and digital marketing
Please include a portfolio with your bids. I cant spend over $250 Thanks! Ronda

item.title: Custom Fishing Rod E-commerce Build
item.description:
30-250 USD | I already have every rod photographed, priced, and described; now I need a complete online store built from the ground up to showcase and sell them. The site must let visitors add products to a cart, pay at checkout, and automatically trigger the usual confirmation emails.
You are free to choose the most suitable stack or platform—as long as the finished store is fast, mobile-friendly, and secure. A clean design that respects my logo, colours, and future branding ideas is important, but the immediate priority is a rock-solid buying experience.
Key deliverables • Fully functional website coded from scratch (or on the framework you propose) • Product catalogue populated with my supplied photos, prices, and descriptions • Integrated payment gateway and tested checkout flow • Basic shipping-rate setup and automated order emails • Admin access so I can add or edit rods later
Acceptance criteria 1. A customer can land on a product page, add a rod to the cart, complete payment, and receive a confirmation email without errors. 2. The site scores at least 90/100 on Google PageSpeed for mobile. 3. All text and images I provide appear exactly as supplied, with no data loss.
If this sounds like your kind of build, let’s talk timeline and the best tech stack to get it live.

item.title: Web Designer Needed for GigResource Refinement -- 2
item.description:
250-750 USD | GigResource — Web Designer JD Refine, don't replace — the site already exists with an established color scheme (navy, teal, pruple , green, and orange), navigation structure, and layout. Nothing gets removed, renamed, or reimagined from scratch. Left sidebar is the top priority — it must be polished, consistent, with proper icon alignment, active states, hover effects, collapsed state on laptop, and mobile-friendly behavior. Responsive design across 3 devices — mobile (purpose-built layout, not a shrunken desktop), laptop (collapsible sidebar), and desktop (full expanded view). Website only — no native app. Scope is open-ended, up to 100+ pages per user— Client, Professional, Influencer, Admin and Affiliate pages across all five user types, plus policy pages, demo/explainer pages, and Outer user pages if requested. Pages with tabs or sub-views must be fully designed in every state, not just the default. Pages and links are not final — the platform is in active development. Pages may be added, removed, or renamed at any time. Revisions and redos are expected and non-negotiable.
Engagement terms the freelancer must accept: stay until GigResource says the project is done; attend all required meetings (2 skipped = work rejected); act on all handoffs, feedback, and flagged issues promptly; remain available and responsive throughout; GigResource can cancel the contract at any time without payment; timeline is approximately 4–6 months but may be uneven. To review the JD for this role, click the weblink, then wait to be accepted then review the fuller details then bid... https://docs.google.com/document/d/1SUGwA99pzro9g0hZLHnqprumRsd2d0z4j4UlGg6_Yps/edit?tab=t.0

item.title: Non-Profit Website Development for Deaf Advocacy

item.title: Website & App Service Booking
item.description:
30-250 USD | I’m purchasing a ready-made platform and need it turned into a clean, intuitive website with a companion mobile app. The core task is to let visitors buy or book services directly from their phone or browser. When a customer books, they must be able to pick the exact service they want along with an available date and time; the system should confirm the slot instantly and update availability in real time.
I already have the platform licence lined up, so your job focuses on front-end build, integration, and making everything feel effortless on both desktop and mobile. If you prefer React, Flutter, Swift/Kotlin, or a solid no-code stack, let me know—what matters most is a smooth, user-friendly flow.
Deliverables • Responsive website fully connected to the booking engine • iOS and Android apps published to their stores • Admin access for me to update services, prices, and time slots • Email/SMS confirmations and calendar sync for users • Short hand-over guide so I can manage basics without coming back to you each time
Acceptance criteria • A new user can land on the site/app, choose a service, see real-time availability, and complete a booking in under two minutes. • All bookings instantly reflect in the admin dashboard and block out that slot for others. • Apps pass App Store and Google Play review on first submission.
If this sounds like your kind of build, send a brief outline of your approach, timeline, and the tech stack you recommend so we can get started.

item.title: Minimalist Squarespace Travel Blog Build
item.description:
30-250 USD | I need a Squarespace site set up so I can chronicle my travels and food discoveries without touching code each time I post. I’d like to be able to post links to businesses and eventually maybe monetize the site. The overall look should stay clean and minimalist, letting photos and stories take center stage. I want it to be easy to use for me and visitors.
Structure • Landing page – full-width hero travel photo, a short welcome blurb, and automatic links to my most recent blog entries. • About Me – a straightforward page that I can edit as my story evolves. • Recipes – organised by meal type (breakfast, lunch, dinner, snacks, drinks, etc.) so visitors can jump straight to what they crave. • Blog – standard post feed where I can add text, images, galleries, or video.
Key goals • Everything must be editable through Squarespace’s built-in editor; no custom code that breaks the drag-and-drop flow. • New posts (or updated ones) should instantly surface on the landing page without additional steps. • Clear, intuitive navigation across the four main sections. • Mobile-responsive design that keeps the same minimal aesthetic. • Basic SEO settings filled in (page titles, descriptions, image alt text templates).
Deliverables 1. Fully functional Squarespace site with the four pages above. 2. Recipe collection set up with categories for each meal type. 3. Blog index that auto-populates the landing page links. 4. One short video or screen-share walkthrough showing me how to add future posts, photos, and recipes. Ideally using my iPad or iPhone.
Once those pieces are in place, I’ll populate the rest of the content myself and take it from there.
Thank you!!

item.title: Fitness Course E-Commerce Website
item.description:
250-750 USD | I’m ready to launch an evergreen fitness & wellness course and need the entire web experience built—from first opt-in through final checkout. Visitors should be able to:
• download a free guide or quiz in exchange for their email, • purchase the full course directly online, and • book a coaching or consultation call if they want deeper support.
Once someone buys, they must receive instant, full access to every lesson inside the course area.
I already have the content; what I’m missing is the technical backbone that blends high-converting funnel pages, a secure e-commerce checkout, automated email sequences for the lead magnet, and a simple calendaring tool for call bookings. I’m flexible on platform—WordPress with WooCommerce, Kajabi, or a comparable stack—as long as it’s reliable and easy for me to update later.
Please outline how you would: 1. Structure the funnel from lead magnet opt-in to course sale. 2. Configure payment processing and course delivery for immediate access. 3. Integrate a booking system that syncs with my calendar. 4. Ensure the site is mobile-responsive, fast, and branded to match my fitness aesthetic.
If you’ve built similar membership or wellness sites, include a couple of live links so I can see your work in action.

item.title: GST-Compliant Secure POS System
item.description:
250-750 AUD | I’m commissioning a ground-up build of a point-of-sale platform designed for an Australian retail shop that needs to stay fully GST compliant while remaining affordable to run. From day one the software must log staff in securely, encrypt all sensitive data, and back itself up automatically. Payments at launch have to include cash, card, digital wallets and the main buy-now-pay-later providers available in Australia. Staff will operate everything from a tablet, so the interface must be touch-first and highly responsive.
To keep delivery clear I’m splitting the work into three consecutive phases:
• Phase 1 delivers the core retail workflow—product catalogue, inventory tracking, sales screens and ATO-ready invoicing. • Phase 2 layers in purchasing modules, supplier records, customer credit handling and a clean reporting suite. • Phase 3 adds advanced analytics, true offline capability with automatic synchronisation once the connection returns, plus multi-store support.
I’ll supply UI sketches, GST rules and any required API keys for payment gateways. You’ll handle architecture, coding, basic UI styling, automated test coverage and packaging for effortless deployment. All data must be protected in transit and at rest, and regular encrypted off-site backups need to run without user input.
Low ongoing cost is critical, so keep third-party fees to a minimum and flag any licensing up front. Please outline the tech stack you prefer, how you’ll tackle offline sync and what milestones you suggest for each phase. I’m ready to get started as soon as we agree on the plan.

item.title: Travel Booking App UI/UX
item.description:
250-750 USD | I’m building a mobile-first app where users can browse and purchase travel experiences, tickets, and event packages, and I need a full set of intuitive, conversion-focused UX and visually cohesive UI designs.
Core screens to be produced: • Browse products or services • Booking / checkout process • Account and order management
Each screen should flow naturally into the next, reduce friction at checkout, and feel consistent with a modern travel marketplace. Clean typography, an easily skimmable card layout for listings, and clear call-to-action hierarchy are top priorities.
High-fidelity mock-ups in Figma (or a comparable tool) plus a clickable prototype will be the final deliverables, ready for hand-off to developers.

item.title: Convert PPT Into Interactive Moodle Course
item.description:
250-750 USD | I have a collection of PowerPoint decks that need to live inside Moodle as fully-featured lessons. For each slide deck, I want the exact slide text and images imported so learners see the familiar content, then wrapped in Moodle’s Lesson activity to create an interactive flow.
After the content is in place, add a short quiz section made up of multiple-choice questions only—no other formats—so learners can check their understanding before moving on.
Audio narration is required for every lesson. You can generate the script directly from the existing slide text (or refine it with Claude if you find phrasing that sounds awkward) and then run it through Murf to produce the voice-over. Please embed or link that audio on each relevant page so it plays seamlessly for the learner.
Deliverables for each deck: • A Moodle Lesson that mirrors the original slides, complete with embedded Murf voice-over. • A set of multiple-choice quiz questions appended at the end of the lesson. • All assets (audio files, question bank entries) organized clearly inside the course so they are easy for me to update later.
I’ll provide the PPT files and course access right away. Let me know your timeframe for converting the first lesson; if all looks good, the remaining decks will follow the same workflow.

item.title: Wix Rental Site With OwnerRez
item.description:
250-750 USD | I’ve already secured my domain on Wix and started a draft, but I’d like a polished, fully functional short-term rental website built from the ground up. The core requirement is to keep everything inside the Wix ecosystem while embedding OwnerRez so guests can complete their reservation without ever leaving my site.
Here’s how I picture the flow: • Visitors land on an inviting Home page featuring the property’s best photos, quick highlights, guest reviews, and an always-visible “Book Now” button. • Clicking that button should open the OwnerRez booking widget directly within the Wix page, not a separate tab. • A dedicated Photo Gallery packed with high-resolution images lets guests explore every room and outdoor space. • An Area Guide page introduces the neighborhood, local attractions, and insider tips to help visitors imagine their stay. • A clear House Rules page spells out check-in times, pet policies, and other must-knows. • A standalone Booking page can echo the embedded OwnerRez form for those who prefer navigating by menu. • A simple Contact page rounds out the site so guests can reach me with special questions.
I’ll supply all copy, photos, and the OwnerRez embed code. You’ll handle: 1. Designing each page in Wix for consistent style and fast load times. 2. Integrating the OwnerRez widget so it displays seamlessly on both desktop and mobile. 3. Optimizing image galleries and arranging content sections for easy scanning and SEO-friendly structure. 4. Setting up basic Wix SEO fields (titles, meta descriptions, alt text) so the site is ready to rank. 5. Providing a quick walkthrough or short Loom video showing how I can update text, swap photos, or adjust availability later.
Acceptance criteria: • OwnerRez interface loads and processes a test booking directly on the Wix site. • All menu links, gallery images, and internal anchors work flawlessly on mobile and desktop. • Site publishes to my existing Wix domain with SSL active. • Hand-off includes clear edit instructions.
If you’ve tackled Wix + OwnerRez before, I’d love to see an example. Let’s get this live and taking bookings soon!

item.title: SEO Blogs from 30 YouTube Videos
item.description:
30-250 AUD | I have a YouTube channel with roughly thirty videos that now need a proper home on my WordPress site. For each video I want a dedicated post that does three things:
• embeds the video close to the top of the page • opens with a short, lively summary that hooks the visitor and makes them hit play • uses original, keyword-smart copy so Google can actually find us
No transcripts or pre-written notes are available—I’m relying on you to watch each video, pull out the key points, and craft a fresh, SEO-friendly article (250–400 words is usually enough when the copy is tight). Headlines, meta description, focus keyphrase, and a handful of internal links should all be in place before you hit publish.
The WordPress site is ready with Gutenberg and Yoast installed. Just pick the right category and tags, upload a thumbnail if the embed doesn’t grab one automatically, set a clean URL slug, and directly publish—one post per video, thirty in total.

item.title: Develop a multi-vendor wholesale directory. Only experienced developers who can show previous multi-vendor wholesale directory work should apply. Budget less than Aud$1000
item.description:
250-750 AUD | I need a full-featured multi-vendor wholesale directory built from the ground up. The platform has three key user stories that must work flawlessly: Budget is AUD$500-$1000 for a simple website which can monetarise.
1. Approved suppliers and buyers create rich business profiles, upload unlimited products with tiered wholesale pricing, and manage stock in their own dashboard. 2. Buyers can post wholesale requests for quotation (RFQ). Suppliers respond inside the platform so both sides can negotiate and track offers in one place. 3. Once an offer is accepted, buyers place wholesale orders and complete payment on-site through a secure gateway. Order, invoice, and shipment data should be recorded for both parties.
Anyone is free to browse public listings, yet only vetted suppliers and buyers should be able to register and unlock the above features. I will handle the approval process from an intuitive admin panel.
Because timing is critical, the first usable release needs to go live ASAP. To keep the timeline tight, prefer proven frameworks (Laravel, Django, Node/React, or similar) and ready-made integrations for payment, KYC, and shipping where possible, but I’m open to your best stack recommendation as long as scalability and security are covered.
Deliverables • Responsive web application (frontend + backend source code) • Role-based access control for public, buyer, supplier, and admin accounts • Product catalogue with bulk import, search/filter, and RFQ workflow • End-to-end order management with integrated payment gateway • Admin dashboard for user approval, fee/commission settings, and analytics • Deployment scripts and concise documentation for future maintenance
Acceptance Criteria • All three core user stories flow without errors on desktop and mobile. • Only approved users can create or respond to RFQs and place orders. • Payments process successfully in test and live modes. • Code passes security audit for common vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10). • Final build deployed to my cloud server and demo walk-through completed.
Show me links or screenshots of previous multi-vendor wholesale or marketplace projects when you reply so I can quickly verify relevant experience and move forward.

item.title: SEO & AI Search Specialist – Airline Elite Status Services
item.description:
30-250 USD | SEO & AI Search Specialist — Airline Elite Status Services | Performance-Based Payment
We’re seeking an experienced SEO specialist or agency to improve Google organic rankings and generate qualified inquiries for our airline elite status services.
Target Markets — English Only
• Primary: United States and Canada • Optional, quoted separately: United Kingdom, Australia, and Singapore
Keyword Scope
Cover all three alliances: Star Alliance Gold, SkyTeam Elite / Elite Plus, and oneworld Sapphire.
Research the following products only:
• United Airlines — elite status / Star Alliance Gold • Delta Air Lines — elite status / SkyTeam Elite Plus • Kenya Airways — Platinum and Silver • Air France — Flying Blue Platinum, Gold, and Silver • Vietnam Airlines — Lotusmiles Platinum, Titanium, and Gold • Royal Jordanian — Gold • Singapore Airlines — KrisFlyer Elite Gold / Star Alliance Gold • Turkish Airlines — Miles&Smiles Elite / Star Alliance Gold • American Airlines — AAdvantage Platinum • SkyTeam Elite Plus Gold • SkyTeam Elite Plus Diamond • Malaysia Airlines — Enrich Gold, offered within a Vietnam Airlines + Malaysia Airlines package
Evaluate relevant buy, upgrade, status match, fast track, and benefits keywords where they accurately describe our services. Do not add airlines or membership tiers outside this list.
First-Priority Keyword Candidates
• Buy Star Alliance Gold • Buy SkyTeam Elite Plus • Buy oneworld Sapphire Status • Vietnam Airlines Platinum Status • Malaysia Airlines Enrich Gold • Royal Jordanian Gold Status • Singapore Airlines KrisFlyer Elite Gold • Turkish Airlines Miles&Smiles Elite
These are initial priorities. Please research and quote relevant keywords for every product listed above.
Customer Positioning
Emphasize priority check-in and boarding, priority baggage handling, additional checked baggage, and verified seating benefits. Lounge access is a supporting benefit.
Clearly distinguish the membership supplied from the partner airlines on which benefits apply. Explain eligibility and restrictions accurately; do not promise guaranteed upgrades.
Required Proposal — Per Keyword, Per Country
Provide a spreadsheet showing:
• Estimated monthly search volume, source, and research date • Organic SEO difficulty and customer search intent • Current ranking, where available, and top 5 competing pages • Estimated time to reach Google’s top 5 organic results • Total price to achieve that milestone, including upfront and recurring charges • Recommended landing page and work required
Provide grouped pricing where related keywords share pages or work, avoiding duplicate charges.
We will select the final keywords and markets after reviewing the data, timelines, and prices.
Scope and Payment
Include technical and on-page SEO, WordPress optimization, content, internal linking, and relevant earned backlinks.
We prefer performance-based payment tied to verified top 5 organic rankings. Tracking tools, locations, devices, ranking retention periods, and payment conditions must be agreed before starting. Paid advertising placements do not count.
White-hat methods only—no spam links, PBNs, fake reviews, or artificial traffic. Provide evidence-based estimates; rankings cannot be guaranteed.
Report rankings, qualified organic traffic, and customer inquiries regularly.
AI Search — Separate Quote
Propose measurable improvements in relevant brand mentions, citations, and recommendations in ChatGPT and other AI search platforms. Specify testing prompts, platforms, measurement methods, and separate payment milestones. AI recommendations cannot be guaranteed.
Reference Websites
• Cobalt Corporate Travel • VIP Hotel Flights • StatusMatch.com
Use these references to analyze keyword targeting, service pages, application flows, and opportunities to differentiate. They do not expand our approved product list or constitute endorsements.
To Apply
Please submit relevant SEO case studies, examples of measurable AI search work, your keyword spreadsheet, estimated timelines, and itemized pricing. Disclose all additional content, outreach, and tool costs.
We’re looking for transparent reporting and reliable long-term cooperation.
Please note: Our website is built with WordPress. This project focuses on SEO and AI search visibility, not a website redesign. Please provide your proposed pricing structure and measurable milestones before we agree on a final budget.

item.title: Scalable WordPress Affiliate Marketing Site with Pre-Researched AI Tools

item.title: Community Learning App Setup
item.description:
30-250 USD | Community App Setup & Content Management for AppyPie.com or CreateCommunity.com DIY platforms
### Project Description
I am looking for an experienced freelancer to help me set up, customize, and populate a community and learning platform using either **Appy Pie** (https://www.appypie.com/) or **CreateCommunity** (https://createcommunity.com/).
The goal is to build a professional, user-friendly platform where members can connect, engage with content, participate in activities, access learning resources, and purchase digital products.
### Responsibilities
The freelancer will be responsible for setting up and organizing the following features, depending on the capabilities of the selected platform:
- **Content Sharing:** Upload, organize, and publish articles, videos, audio teachings, documents, and regular updates. - **Member Discussions & Groups:** Set up discussion spaces, community groups, and opportunities for members to interact. - **Events & Registration:** Create event listings, registration forms, sign-ups, announcements, and event notifications. - **User Accounts & Profiles:** Configure member registration, login, personal profiles, and account management. - **Personal Member Library:** Set up a section where users can access their saved content, enrolled courses, and purchased digital products. - **Ebook & Audiobook Shop:** Configure a digital storefront where users can browse and purchase ebooks and audiobooks, preferably with protected in-app reading and listening rather than unrestricted downloads. - **Courses & Learning Resources:** Organize educational content into courses, lessons, modules, and learning pathways. - **Notifications & Announcements:** Configure notifications to keep members informed about new content, events, and community activities. - **Membership & Access Management:** Set up free and paid content access, member permissions, and appropriate restrictions. - **Navigation & User Experience:** Organize all features into a clean, intuitive interface that works well on mobile and desktop. - **Testing & Launch Preparation:** Test registration, content access, purchases, navigation, and other essential functions before launch.
### Requirements
- Experience setting up community apps, membership platforms, or online learning platforms. - Familiarity with Appy Pie or CreateCommunity is strongly preferred. - Experience integrating digital product sales, user libraries, and membership features. - Ability to determine which features are supported natively and which require integrations or custom solutions. - Strong organizational skills and attention to detail. - Ability to work independently and communicate progress clearly.
### IMPORTANT — PLEASE READ BEFORE APPLYING
I am looking for someone who **understands this concept and knows how to implement it**, not someone who will simply experiment with the platforms.
Please answer the following questions in your proposal:
1. Have you worked with Appy Pie or CreateCommunity before? Which platform? 2. Have you built a similar community, membership, or learning app? Please share examples. 3. Do you understand the features listed above, and are you confident you can implement them? 4. Which of these features can be implemented directly on your recommended platform, and which would require third-party integrations? 5. Can you configure an ebook and audiobook store with individual user accounts and a personal library of purchased content? 6. What is your estimated timeline and total cost for completing the setup?
**Please do not submit a generic proposal.** Explain how you would approach this project and demonstrate that you understand the technical requirements.
**Project Type:** One-time setup, with potential for ongoing content management and technical support.
**Budget:** Open to proposals based on experience and project scope.

item.title: PHP Full-Stack Developer with Laravel – Long-Term Collaboration
item.description:
750-1500 EUR | PHP Full-Stack Developer with Laravel – Long-Term Collaboration
We are looking for a PHP Full-Stack Developer to help us develop and improve our ERP platform, Systalavista, over the long term. Build frontend and backend features, improve existing modules, and take tasks from requirements analysis through to tested implementation.
